steps.title: Shuffle & Cut
text: Both players shuffle their decks, then the opponent may cut.
Each player shuffles their own deck thoroughly. After shuffling, present your deck to your opponent.
Your opponent may then shuffle or cut your deck (be careful when touching your opponent's cards).

steps.title: Determine First Turn
text: Decide who goes first using rock-paper-scissors or a coin flip.
The winner chooses to go first or second. For subsequent Duels, the loser of the previous Duel decides who goes first.
If the previous Duel ended in a tie, determine with another random method.
**The player who goes first does draw during their first Draw Phase** (starting with 6 cards after drawing).
The player who goes first cannot conduct a Battle Phase during their very first turn.

steps.title: Determine First Turn
text: Decide who goes first using rock-paper-scissors or a coin flip.
The winner chooses to go first or second. For subsequent Duels, the loser of the previous Duel decides who goes first.
If the previous Duel ended in a tie, determine with another random method.
**The player who goes first does not draw during their first Draw Phase**.
The player who goes first cannot conduct a Battle Phase during their very first turn.

steps.title: Draw Starting Hand
text: Each player draws 5 cards from the top of their Deck.
Both players draw 5 cards from the top of their Main Deck. This is your starting hand before the first Draw Phase.

steps.title: Deck — Main Deck
text: Minimum 40 cards (no upper limit).
Max 3 copies of any card (Main Deck + Side Deck combined).

steps.title: Deck — Fusion Deck
text: Contains only Fusion Monsters.
No size limit — you may include as many Fusion Monsters as you want.
Cards in the Fusion Deck are not counted toward the 40-card minimum.
Max 3 copies of the same card.

steps.title: Deck — Side Deck
text: Exactly 15 cards.
Swap cards between Side Deck and Main Deck between Duels in a Match.
Must remain exactly 15 cards after swapping.

steps.title: Deck — Main Deck
text: 40 to 60 cards.
Max 3 copies of any card (Main Deck + Extra Deck + Side Deck combined).

steps.title: Deck — Extra Deck
text: 0 to 15 cards.
Contains Synchro Monsters and Fusion Monsters.
Not counted toward the 40-card minimum.

steps.title: Deck — Extra Deck
text: 0 to 15 cards.
Contains Xyz Monsters, Synchro Monsters, and Fusion Monsters.

steps.title: Deck — Extra Deck
text: 0 to 15 cards.
Contains Pendulum Monsters (face-up), Xyz, Synchro, and Fusion Monsters.

steps.title: Deck — Extra Deck
text: 0 to 15 cards.
Contains Link Monsters, Pendulum Monsters (face-up), Xyz, Synchro, and Fusion Monsters.

steps.title: Deck — Side Deck
text: 0 to 15 cards.
Swap cards between Side Deck, Main Deck, and Extra Deck between Duels.

steps.title: Deck — Side Deck
text: 0 to 15 cards.
